text: dsh-strata-sync 是面向 DSH Web 设置界面的 Strata 模型同步插件。它读取 Strata Server 已加载的模型信息，在 DSH 设置页提供差异预览与同步流程，并更新模型上下文、输出上限和 Agent preset 的压缩预算。用户可选择跟随已加载模型、手动设置输出额度、查看同步状态，并编辑动态摘要长度提示及其触发模式。适合希望让 DSH 配置匹配本地 Strata 模型的用户；需要在 DSH 中预先配置 Strata provider，插件复用现有凭据。

dsh-strata-sync connects DSH with the model loaded in Strata Server. It previews and synchronizes context, output, and compaction budgets. Users can follow the loaded model and tune summary length guidance. Configure a Strata provider in DSH first; its connection is reused.
让 DSH 自动跟上 Strata 当前加载的模型。
我想把 Strata 的上下文窗口同步到 DSH。
能预览模型设置变化再应用吗？
帮我根据模型上下文调整 DSH 的压缩预算。
如何让 DSH 的默认模型匹配本地 Strata？
想给摘要提示加一个可调的目标长度。
Keep DSH model and context settings aligned with my Strata server.
Preview model budget changes before applying them in DSH.
dsh-strata-sync 的功能「同步模型与上下文」：读取 Strata 已加载模型，预览差异后更新 DSH 模型、上下文与输出预算。。
dsh-strata-sync 的功能「协调压缩预算」：根据上下文窗口、输出额度计算压缩触发与保留预算，并应用到启用的 Agent preset。。
dsh-strata-sync 的功能「动态摘要长度提示」：在支持的原生摘要请求中估算目标长度并补充提示，可选择每次启用或截断后启用。。
dsh-strata-sync 的功能「管理同步偏好」：设置页支持选择 Strata provider、跟随已加载模型、手动输出额度及摘要提示偏好。。

dsh-strata-sync README · dsh-strata-sync：**English** · [简体中文](https://github.com/ethan741205/dsh-strata-sync/blob/main/docs/README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](https://github.com/ethan741205/dsh-strata-sync/blob/main/docs/README.zh-TW.md)

Connect **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** to the model loaded in **Strata Server**, with model settings and summary controls in one DSH settings page.

dsh-strata-sync README · dsh-strata-sync：The plugin reads Strata's model information, previews the changes, and updates DSH's custom model and context-compaction budgets. It also adds an editable length instruction to supported summary requests, helping the model keep checkpoints concise.

dsh-strata-sync README · What you can do：- **Sync model settings:** context window, response output limit, and confirmed input types and reasoning levels.
- **Align compaction budgets:** update the matching policies in enabled DSH Agent presets.
- **Control summary length:** edit the supplemental prompt and adjust two target-length ratios.
- **Sync on startup:** optionally synchronize once when DSH starts.
- **Review and recover:** preview differences, back up settings, and view the last synchronization result.

dsh-strata-sync README · What you can do：Strata Server is read-only to this plugin. Synchronization does not switch or load server models, change server settings, or send test inference requests. Unconfirmed model capabilities keep their existing DSH values.

dsh-strata-sync README · What's new in 0.12.13：- Removed activation-only and periodic server checks. The existing startup-sync switch remains off by default; when enabled, it synchronizes once per DSH start. Manual checks and synchronization remain available.
- Check and synchronization times now use the system locale and time zone, with the UTC offset displayed.
- Server diagnostics appear once above the main workflow. Redundant startup-sync hints were removed.

dsh-strata-sync README · What's new in 0.12.11：- Summary guidance now supports native image attachments, including images returned by tools. Source-length and output-room estimates account for images separately while preserving the original messages and attachments.
- Diagnostics identify unsupported content and invalid fields using fixed categories, with numeric image costs. Conversation text, image data, attachment identifiers and paths are never copied into audit records.
- A truncated request with unsupported input can arm guidance for the next supported request; successful native checkpoint commitment resets recovery as before.

dsh-strata-sync README · What's new in 0.12.8：- Native session diagnostics record each calculated summary target, whether the instruction was actually applied, and why it was skipped.
- Each request's stream result links to DSH's existing compaction events, distinguishing truncation, cancellation and generation completion from a committed checkpoint.
- Diagnostics contain bounded metadata only. They preserve summary behavior and never send additional inference requests.
- The optional integration uses DSH's experimental plugin-record API; unavailable logging does not block summaries.

dsh-strata-sync README · What's new in 0.12.8：See the [audit event format and native persistence test](https://github.com/ethan741205/dsh-strata-sync/blob/main/docs/SUMMARY_AUDIT.md) and [validation notes](https://github.com/ethan741205/dsh-strata-sync/blob/main/docs/VALIDATION.md). Automated native persistence verification uses controlled responses. Two additional live Strata compactions completed without truncation: the default mode recorded no applied target, and every-summary mode recorded an applied 1,328-token target. All 45 saved events reloaded unchanged through the native reader.

dsh-strata-sync README · 1. Prepare the connection：Load a model in Strata Server. In **DSH → Settings → Models**, configure its OpenAI-compatible provider, API URL and credentials, with an explicit custom model entry.

The plugin reuses that connection; you do not need to copy an API key into it.

dsh-strata-sync README · 2. Install the plugin：In DSH's plugin manager, choose **Add plugin** and enter:

```text
dsh-strata-sync
```

Or, after finishing active tasks and fully quitting DSH Desktop, use the official CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-strata-sync --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
```

Reopen DSH if needed to load the settings page. If the plugin is disabled, enable it in the plugin manager.

dsh-strata-sync README · 3. Preview and synchronize：Open **Settings → dsh-strata-sync**:

The main flow appears first: **Check differences → Review changes → Back up and sync**. **Sync preferences** and the optional **Dynamic summary target** are collapsed below it; expand them to adjust options or edit the supplemental prompt.

The change preview shows the conversation budget, compaction headroom, summary output cap, effective compaction trigger and recent-content retention. The formulas explain how the proposed budgets were calculated.

dsh-strata-sync README · 3. Preview and synchronize：1. Select your Strata provider and click **Save preferences**.
2. Click **Check differences** to inspect the loaded model and proposed changes.
3. Click **Back up and sync**.
4. **Start a new conversation** to use the updated model and Agent preset settings.

dsh-strata-sync README · 3. Preview and synchronize：Existing conversations keep their selected model route and preset revision. To make future setup automatic, enable **Automatically sync when DSH starts** and save. This option is off by default and takes effect on the next start; it can run during tasks but synchronizes only once.

dsh-strata-sync README · When the server model changes：With **Automatically sync when DSH starts** enabled, the plugin synchronizes once per DSH start, even with Settings closed. The switch remains off by default. There is no separate check on plugin activation and no periodic server checks. Reopening Settings or reloading the plugin does not repeat a completed startup attempt. A failed attempt is reported without automatic network retries; use **Check differences → Back up and sync** to try manually.

dsh-strata-sync README · When the server model changes：After switching models in Strata during a DSH session, use **Check differences → Back up and sync**, then **start a new conversation**. The displayed check and synchronization results are historical records, not continuous verification of the server or confirmation that an existing conversation uses the new budgets. Startup synchronization does not modify active conversations or send inference requests.

dsh-strata-sync README · Model and output settings：| Setting | How it is chosen |
|---|---|
| Model and context | Strata's loaded text model and verified context capacity. |
| Response output limit | Manual override, if set; otherwise the verified Strata output default. If unavailable or unlimited, use Strata's formula: 30% of context, at least 4,096 and at most 32,768 tokens. |
| Input types | Confirmed server capabilities, such as text or text plus image. |
| Reasoning levels | Verified model-template support; unknown templates preserve existing settings. |
| Default model | Follows the loaded Strata model when **Follow the loaded Strata model as the default** is enabled. |

dsh-strata-sync README · Model and output settings：Keep **Follow Strata output limit** enabled for automatic selection. Turn it off to set a manual override under **Advanced settings**. The preview shows the server default, effective value and source separately.

dsh-strata-sync README · Model and output settings：Quantization does not change the choices for a verified model family: Qwen3.8 Flash Next offers `off / low / medium / xhigh`; the current DeepSeek Flash template offers `off / low / medium / high / max` and defaults to `high`. Older verified templates keep their supported choices. Sync updates the available choices without changing the selected effort. See [verified capabilities](https://github.com/ethan741205/dsh-strata-sync/blob/main/docs/CAPABILITIES.md).

dsh-strata-sync README · Model and output settings：The fallback follows [Strata's local output formula](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/blob/main/apps/host/server/agent/profile.mjs): `max(4096, min(32768, floor(context × 0.3)))`.

dsh-strata-sync README · Model and output settings：When synchronizing, the plugin normally sets a 4,096-token summary output cap and compaction headroom. For small windows using calculated output, both are limited to half the remaining conversation budget, rounded down; an 8K window therefore uses 2,048. The effective compaction trigger is the smaller of **80% of context** and **context − response output − headroom**. Recent-content retention is **(context − response output) × 16%**, rounded down. These compaction budgets are calculated by the plugin, not supplied by Strata.

dsh-strata-sync README · Model and output settings：For example, with automatic output calculation, a 32K context uses a 9,830-token response allowance and an 18,842-token compaction trigger. It does **not** necessarily compact at 80%.

dsh-strata-sync README · Summary prompt and target length：**Dynamic summary target** is on by default, using **After summary truncation**. You can disable it or choose when to supplement DSH's native summary instructions:

dsh-strata-sync README · Summary prompt and target length：| Mode | Behavior |
|---|---|
| **After summary truncation** (`after-truncation`, the default mode) | Start with the native instruction. If a summary hits its output-token limit, add length guidance to the next native compaction for the same conversation, provider and model. Keep guidance active through unsuccessful attempts; after successful compaction, return to the native instruction. |
| **Every summary** (`always`) | Add the length instruction to every supported summary, including the first attempt. |

dsh-strata-sync README · Summary prompt and target length：The mode is saved as `summaryGuidanceMode`; `summaryGuidance` remains the enable switch. When disabled, DSH uses its native summary and compaction behavior. Choosing a mode does not enable guidance by itself.

dsh-strata-sync README · Summary prompt and target length：**After summary truncation** waits for DSH's next compaction attempt; it does not immediately retry or send another model request. Cancellation, network/authentication errors and context-overflow errors do not activate it. Recovery state is kept only in memory and clears when guidance is disabled, the mode changes, or the plugin reloads or restarts. Conversations do not share recovery state.

The editable **Supplemental summary prompt** starts with:

dsh-strata-sync README · Summary prompt and target length：```text
Keep the entire checkpoint, including all required headings, within a target of {target} tokens.
```

Keep `{target}` in your text—it is replaced with the calculated token target whenever guidance applies. The template can contain up to 2,048 characters. Use **Restore default prompt** to reset it, then **Save preferences** to apply your choice.

Two divisors control the target (both default to **2**, or **50%**):

dsh-strata-sync README · Summary prompt and target length：| Divisor | Default | Limits the target to |
|---|---:|---|
| Output budget (O) | 2 | Estimated effective summary output budget ÷ O |
| Source length (S) | 2 | Estimated content being summarized ÷ S |

The target is the smaller result, rounded down. All divisors accept decimals of at least 1. Existing output/source divisors and explicit enable choices are preserved. New or unspecified guidance is **on**, using **After summary truncation**; explicitly disabled configurations stay disabled.

dsh-strata-sync README · Summary prompt and target length：The effective output budget is an **estimate**, not the raw requested `maxTokens` or a server-confirmed cap. It is the smaller of the request's summary cap and estimated remaining context. The latter uses the smaller verified server/client window, subtracts the full prompt (including system text, tool schemas and the supplement), and allows for the supported pi-ai adapter's 4,096-token safety reserve. Text is estimated at 3.5 characters/token with extra framing. The separate source estimate uses DSH's four-character heuristic and excludes the system prompt, tools and summary instruction. Neither estimate is an exact tokenizer count.

dsh-strata-sync README · Summary prompt and target length：For example, a 4,096-token effective output budget with enough source content gives a **2,048-token target** in either 32K or 64K context. A 2,000-token source instead gives a **1,000-token target**. Less remaining context can reduce the target further. The target is calculated for each supported summary request; the change preview does not display a target estimate.

dsh-strata-sync README · Summary prompt and target length：Native PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF attachment references are supported. The source estimate follows DSH's serialized-reference heuristic. Output-room estimation reserves at least 1,372 tokens per image using pi-ai's heuristic, plus the native image description, available access-path text and framing. Images are retained and never priced as zero; unsupported attachments and malformed fields leave the native request unchanged with a specific diagnostic category.

dsh-strata-sync README · Summary prompt and target length：This is a writing instruction, **not a hard output limit or a guarantee against truncation**. Reasoning may consume the same output budget; the plugin does not change reasoning, `maxTokens`, `fit_max_tokens` or compaction timing. The server's actual tokenizer, later middleware, or a different adapter version may impose a lower limit.

dsh-strata-sync README · Summary prompt and target length：Saving summary preferences does not change model budgets. Native prompt content is preserved, and no extra inference or retry loop is added. If the request cannot be verified or safely estimated, or the target is below 256 tokens, the original summary request proceeds unchanged.

dsh-strata-sync README · Backups and compatibility：Settings writes create a backup of `cordis.patch.yml` under the profile's `backups/strata-sync/` directory. Synchronization checks for concurrent edits and attempts to roll back completed changes if a later step fails. Backups may contain private configuration; keep them local.

Removing the plugin does not undo previously synchronized settings. To restore a backup, fully quit DSH first.

dsh-strata-sync README · Backups and compatibility：Tested with **DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3**. Use an API-key or unauthenticated OpenAI-compatible provider with an explicit custom model list and an enabled Agent preset containing `compaction-basic`. Contexts below 8,192 tokens, catalog-only providers, nonempty `modelOverrides`, and ambiguous loaded-model metadata are unsupported.

dsh-strata-sync README · Backups and compatibility：See [verified capabilities and reasoning mappings](https://github.com/ethan741205/dsh-strata-sync/blob/main/docs/CAPABILITIES.md) and [validation notes](https://github.com/ethan741205/dsh-strata-sync/blob/main/docs/VALIDATION.md) for technical details and test coverage.

dsh-strata-sync README · Development：Requires Node.js 22 or newer.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ethan741205/dsh-strata-sync.git
cd dsh-strata-sync
npm ci
npm test

To install your build, fully quit DSH and run `dsh plugin --profile desktop add <path-to-generated.tgz>`.

Source: `src/plugin.mjs` (host integration), `src/core.mjs` (discovery and budgets), `src/summary.mjs` (summary guidance), and `src/client.js` (settings UI).
